map.基于NRS-2002改良的IBD营养风险筛查，评估营养状态与营养支持需求: IBD nutrition risk screening based on a modified NRS-2002, assessing nutritional status and nutrition support needs.
map.核心计算公式（按输入变量）：max(diseaseScore,1)；max(di: Core formula (by input variables): max(diseaseScore,1); max(diseaseScore,2); max(nutriScore,2)
map.近3个月体重下降 (%): Weight loss in the last 3 months (%)
map.减少＞75%或几乎不进食: Reduced by >75% or almost no eating
map.BMI 18.5-20.5 + 一般情况差 / 摄入减少25-50%: BMI 18.5-20.5 + poor general condition / intake reduced 25-50%
map.总分≥3分提示存在营养风险，需制定营养支持计划。年龄≥70岁加1分。: A total score ≥3 indicates nutrition risk and requires a nutrition support plan. Age ≥70 adds 1 point.
map.CD营养不良发生率高于UC（30-50% vs 5-10%）: Malnutrition incidence in CD is higher than UC (30-50% vs 5-10%)
map.常见缺乏：铁、维生素B12、叶酸、锌、维生素D: Common deficiencies: iron, vitamin B12, folate, zinc, vitamin D
map.CD小肠受累者更易发生吸收不良和微营养素缺乏: Small-bowel involvement in CD more often causes malabsorption and micronutrient deficiency
map.生长迟缓是儿童和青少年IBD的重要表现: Growth failure is an important manifestation in children and adolescents with IBD
map.营养不良增加手术并发症风险和感染风险: Malnutrition increases surgical complication and infection risk
map.：ONS为主，必要时肠内营养（EN）: : mainly ONS, enteral nutrition (EN) if needed
map.：肠内营养（EN）为首选，必要时联合PN: : enteral nutrition (EN) is first choice, combine PN if needed
map.：独家肠内营养（EEN）可诱导缓解（尤其儿童/青少年）: : exclusive enteral nutrition (EEN) can induce remission (especially in children/adolescents)
map.：术前7-14天营养支持降低并发症: : nutritional support 7-14 days before surgery lowers complications
map.提示：IBD患者应常规进行营养筛查。CD患者、病变广泛者、活动期患者营养风险更高: Note: IBD patients should routinely undergo nutrition screening. CD patients, those with extensive disease, and those in the active phase carry higher nutrition risk. Iron and vitamin B12 deficiency need regular monitoring and supplementation. Enteral nutrition is superior to parenteral nutrition. For clinical reference only.
map.📚 深度解析：IBD 营养风险筛查（NRS-2002 改良）: 📚 Deep Dive: IBD Nutrition Risk Screening (Modified NRS-2002)
map.营养筛查：IBD 活动期/围手术期评估营养风险等级: Nutrition screening: assess nutrition risk level in the IBD active phase / perioperative period
map.支持计划：中重度风险制定 ONS/EN/PN 方案: Support plan: formulate ONS/EN/PN plans for moderate-to-high risk
map.微营养纠正：补铁、B12、叶酸、维生素 D: Micronutrient correction: supplement iron, B12, folate, vitamin D
map.算法：营养状态取最高项 —: Algorithm: nutritional status takes the highest item —
map.<17→3、17~18.5→2、18.5~20.5→1 分；体重下降 >10%→: <17→3, 17~18.5→2, 18.5~20.5→1 point; weight loss >10%→3, 5~10%→2, <5%→1 point; intake reduced >75%→3, 50~75%→2, 25~50%→1 point; albumin <30→+2, 30~35→+1 point. Disease severity (activity 1~3 + extent + complications) 0~3 points; age ≥70 adds 1 point. Total ≥5 severe, ≥3 moderate, <3 low nutrition risk.
map.例：BMI 18.5、体重下降 8%、白蛋白 32g/L、摄入减少 25~50%: Example: BMI 18.5, weight loss 8%, albumin 32 g/L, intake reduced 25~50%, mild activity, limited disease, no complications, age 45 → nutrition 2 (weight loss) + disease 1 + age 0 = 3 points, moderate nutrition risk; mainly ONS is advised. If BMI 16, weight loss 12%, albumin 28, intake reduced >75%, severe activity, total colon, 2 complications, age 45 → nutrition 3 + disease 3 + age 0 = 6 points, severe nutrition risk; early EN (PN if necessary) is advised, and CD should consider EEN to induce remission.
map.IBD 患者要低纤维饮食吗？: Should IBD patients follow a low-fiber diet?
map.缓解期无需严格限纤维；活动期或狭窄/穿透性病变者需低渣饮食减少残渣刺激。营养支持: No strict fiber restriction is needed in remission; during the active phase or with stricturing/penetrating lesions, a low-residue diet reduces stool irritation. Nutrition support should first guarantee energy 25~30 kcal/kg/d and protein 1.0~1.5 g/kg/d rather than blindly fasting.
map.为什么活动期要查白蛋白？: Why check albumin during the active phase?
map.白蛋白反映炎症与营养双重状态，IBD 活动期因炎症消耗与肠道丢失常下降；<30g: Albumin reflects both inflammatory and nutritional status, and in the IBD active phase it often falls due to inflammatory consumption and intestinal loss; <30 g/L indicates moderate-to-severe nutrition risk, requiring active supplementation, and only controlling inflammation can fundamentally improve it.
